relicReset.note: Ordinary relics are one permanent choice per tier. Rejuvenated adds one earlier-tier relic; it does not reset or replace existing picks.

relics.name: Endless Harvest
relics.summary: Banking and persistence for core gathering skills.
details: Automatically sends Archaeology, Farming, Fishing, Mining and Woodcutting resources to the relevant storage.
Fishing, Mining and Woodcutting have a 10% chance to upgrade a resource by one tier.
Standard trees remain available when you are the one chopping; moved fishing spots are followed; felled trees are resumed after regrowth.
Mining stamina remains at 100%.
Archaeology time sprites stay in place and follow the player.

relics.name: Survivalist
relics.summary: Best-tier gathering tools, doubled resources and Archaeology acceleration.
details: The Survivalist's bag stores logs, fish and ore and supplies highest-tier Mining, Woodcutting and Fishing tools.
Fishing, Mining, Woodcutting and Archaeology excavation resources are doubled; the extra resources do not award extra XP.
Rockertunities and critical swings deal double damage; rockertunities immediately award an ore.
Archaeology sprite focus gain is doubled and discovery immediately reaches 100% focus.
Discovered artefacts have a 50% chance to restore immediately and award restoration XP.

relics.name: Golden Touch
relics.summary: Agility, Thieving, coins, Prayer XP and supply generation.
details: Goldenhawk boots periodically grant Agility XP while running, skilling or using ultimate abilities.
Agility or Thieving XP can produce feathers worth 50,000 coins or Prayer XP.
Agility laps award 10,000 coins per Agility level and double lap XP; course failures are removed.
Thieving cannot fail, loot is noted and tripled, stalls and chests do not deplete, and safes have no cooldown.
Pickpocket and stall non-coin loot is tripled; Thieving coins are multiplied by 100.
Chests and safes can send herb or potion-ingredient bundles to the bank.

relics.name: Animal Wrangler
relics.summary: A broad Fishing, Hunter, Farming and BGH engine—not a narrow fishing pick.
details: Fishing and Hunter loot can be automatically banked.
Fishing or Hunter catches can produce farm animals, with an Anachronia dinosaur alternative.
Fishing, Hunter and farm-animal harvests can bank herbs or seeds.
Farm animals have perfect stats, need no food and sell for maximum beans.
Hunter catches cannot fail; Hunter loot and marks are multiplied by five and traps attract faster.
Fishing needs no bait and always catches an additional fish.
Anachronia and Havenhythe BGH need no bait and creatures take twice as long to catch you.
Spirit moths give ten times the charms; farm animals are twenty times more common.

relics.name: Superheated
relics.summary: Combines Firemaking, Cooking, Mining/Smithing and material production.
details: Woodcutting can auto-burn logs and Fishing can auto-cook catches without level requirements.
Bonfires consume a log every 0.6 seconds; one incense stick grants maximum potency for 60 minutes.
Blessed fire spirits replace ordinary spirits, occur more often and can also spawn from Smithing.
Smelting always makes double bars, with a 3% chance for 50 extra bars, and can process up to 60 bars.
In-progress Smithing grants Invention materials as if the item were disassembled.
Smithing stays at maximum heat and gains triple base progress.
Ceremonial swords grant five times Smithing XP and 50 bars; burial-set XP is tripled.

relics.name: Divine Druid
relics.summary: Herblore, Summoning and Divination supply compression.
details: Thera's pouch stores grimy herbs and charms and supplies infinite spirit shards and Summoning pouches.
Grimy herbs can become unfinished potions and herbs can be cleaned all at once.
Gathering can frequently produce herbs and charms; enemy charm drops are multiplied by five.
Pouch creation can bank an extra pouch and ten matching scrolls; familiar skill boosts are tripled.
Potion making has a 75% ingredient-save chance.
Only enriched memories are gathered and conversion uses half the energy.
Memory conversion can bank a porter or divine charge; memory strands are multiplied by ten and chronicle XP is doubled.
Divine-energy crafting uses half the energy and all Meilyr potion recipes are unlocked.

relics.name: Nature's Network
relics.summary: Instant Farming plus direct teleports to nature transport and patches.
details: The fairy mushroom teleports to fairy rings, spirit trees and farming patches.
Patches harvest instantly and produce is noted.
Planted seeds grow immediately.
All patches act as ultracomposted.
Planting has a 25% seed-save chance.
Herb patches plant the maximum seed count while consuming only the base amount.

relics.name: Assassin's Insight
relics.summary: Slayer routing, task control, elite spawns and guaranteed ushabti capture.
details: The skull teleports to Slayer masters and a range of Slayer dungeons and monsters.
Assignments offer two choices and can be requested at minimum or maximum size.
Prefer and block changes are free.
Corrupted slayer mask effects are always active.
Elite Slayer monsters are five times more common and award five times Slayer XP before League multipliers.
Ushabti capture succeeds every time.

relics.name: Voidwalker
relics.summary: Very broad jewellery teleports plus mixed supply drops.
details: The abyssal conduit provides unlimited teleports from major glory, bracelet, necklace, pendant and ring teleport sets.
Void shards can award a clue and supplies including Summoning pouches, divine energy/charges, Invention materials, dragon equipment, feathers, geodes, blessed fire spirits or crystal essence.

relics.name: Crystal Grace
relics.summary: Runecrafting, Necromancy rituals, Prayer and spell access.
details: Seren's crystal tiara is an omni-tiara, teleports to unlocked Runecrafting altars and acts as a demonhorn necklace.
All Magic spells are unlocked.
Any XP gain has a 5% chance to produce stackable crystal essence that substitutes for pure or impure essence.
Rune output is tripled and level-based rune multipliers are always at their maximum.
Necromancy rituals act with 200% multiplicity, attraction and protection and the maximum 50% speed increase.
Light sources and glyphs require no ingredients.
Burying or offering a bone adds Dragon-bone-equivalent Prayer XP.

relics.name: Transmutation
relics.summary: Converts resource tiers and can automate noted stacks.
details: The Deities' Transmuter enables toggleable transmutation through alchemy spells.
Divine Convergence downgrades up to ten resources; Divine Divergence upgrades up to ten.
Outputs are banked when noted.
The spells have no level requirement and award 10 Magic XP per item before League multipliers.
Noted stacks can be automatically recast while they remain in the same inventory slot.

relics.name: Antiquarian
relics.summary: The complete Archaeology acceleration package.
details: All Archaeology relics are available after the tutorial.
Materials go to storage or bank; the monolith has 1,000 energy and the journal is a free soil screener.
Fixate is immediate and unlimited.
Lore pages are 20% more common in addition to the passive.
Collections award ten times chronotes, replacing the passive five-times multiplier.
Artefact restoration uses half the materials; collections award ancient caskets.
Artefact or lore-page discovery immediately reaches 100% focus.
Divine geodes from excavation contain Archaeology materials.

relics.name: Clue Connoisseur
relics.summary: Maximum clue speed, access and reward volume.
details: Uri's briefcase stores clues and caskets and teleports to unlocked-region hidey-holes.
The Globetrotter outfit is unlocked and all hidey-holes count as filled.
Treasure Trail points are tripled and each clue gives an extra casket.
Clues start at the minimum step count and caskets award the maximum loot-roll count.
Sealed clues are twice as common and have no carrying cap.

relics.name: Production Master
relics.summary: Mass-processes production and compresses the largest late skilling batches.
details: The Brooch of the Spirits is granted.
Many production activities process their entire batch at once.
Food never burns.
The brooch can spawn Seren spirits, divine blessings, catalysts of alteration and manifested knowledge.
Infinite exquisite urns and portable-station benefits are available everywhere.
Applicable masterwork items complete in one action.
Construction, Cooking, Crafting, Herblore, Fletching and Smithing receive a +6 boost.

relics.name: Devout
relics.summary: A mobile bank and heavily scaled familiar package.
details: The Devout yak has 32 inventory slots, remote bank access and note/un-note controls.
The repeat-un-note scroll is infinite and costs no Summoning points.
Skill-boosting familiars award 10 base XP in their boosted skill up to every six seconds.
Summoning scrolls are not consumed and familiar spell-point costs fall to 10%.
Familiar damage scales with Summoning level up to +500% at level 99.

relics.name: Perkfection
relics.summary: A large Invention package whose value depends on the remaining route—not a flat DPS multiplier.
details: The toolbox is an XP capacitor with ten times storage and ten times charging speed.
Two freely swappable gizmo slots apply in addition to equipped perks while an augmented item is active.
The toolbox teleports to Invention workbenches in unlocked areas.
Junk chance can be reduced to zero.
Machines are available from level 1, run ten times faster and have ten times capacity.
Disassembly gives ten times Invention materials.
Augmented items and machines consume no charge.
Helpful perks trigger 20% more often, without stacking with the item-level-20 benefit.
All Dwarven and Goblin technology blueprints are unlocked.

relics.name: Rejuvenated
relics.summary: Adds one complete relic from Tiers 1–5; it does not reset or replace a relic.
details: Choose one additional relic from a previous tier.

relics.name: Infernal Fire
relics.summary: Universal Death Mark and a 20% execute with a small pocket stat package.
details: All four combat styles apply Death Mark every time while the Avernic star is carried or worn.
Death Mark kills a marked target at 20% life and grants 5% adrenaline on the kill.
Pocket stats: +18.7 damage bonus for every style and +15 Prayer bonus.

relics.name: Naragi Edict
relics.summary: Burst stats, healing and one death save for first clears and dangerous encounters.
details: The Sliver of Edicts activates for 16.8 seconds on a 1.5-minute cooldown.
During the active it heals 10,000 life points four times at 4.2-second intervals, boosts combat stats to 255 and revives the player on death.
Pocket stats: +300 Armour, +14 all-style damage, +1,500 life points and +15 Prayer.

relics.name: Icyenic Faith
relics.summary: Prayer-scaled damage/crit plus major protection and sustain.
details: The Tome of the Icyene provides +50 Prayer bonus when worn.
Each Prayer-bonus point grants 0.2% critical chance and 0.2% base ability damage.
Protection prayers and deflect curses block an additional 50% damage and also act as Soul Split.

blessings.name: Adrenaline Junkie
blessings.summary: Raises adrenaline capacity and generation.
details: Maximum adrenaline +50%.
Adrenaline generation +50%.

blessings.name: Big Boned
blessings.summary: Large life increase plus a per-damage-instance life-scaled rider.
details: Maximum life points +50%.
Player-sourced damage gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.

blessings.name: Teragard's Aegis
blessings.summary: Armour adds base ability damage and regeneration.
details: Base ability damage gains 25% of total Armour, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life with the same multipliers.

blessings.name: Abyssal Cinders
blessings.summary: Per-hit bonus damage and an Inferno proc.
details: On hit, attacks add 15% ability damage.
On hit, attacks have a 5% chance to trigger a 100–200% single-target Inferno of Zamorak.

blessings.name: Barkscales
blessings.summary: Armour-based damage reduction that charges Grasp of Guthix.
details: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of Armour value.
After five reductions, Grasp of Guthix deals 80–120% ability damage as poison in a 3×3 area at the attacker.

blessings.name: Striking Light
blessings.summary: Basic-attack damage plus an armour-scaled Light hit.
details: Basic-attack damage +40%.
Basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin on a 9-second cooldown for 40–60% ability damage plus 250% Armour value.

blessings.name: Avernic Rampage
blessings.summary: A state-changing free-adrenaline-cost window.
details: On attack, 5% chance to activate for 7.2 seconds.
During the window, abilities and special attacks cost 0% adrenaline.

blessings.name: Eternal Sustenance
blessings.summary: Food becomes free and no longer drains adrenaline.
details: Food is not consumed when eaten.
Eating no longer loses adrenaline.

blessings.name: Steadfast Will
blessings.summary: Empowers Bash, Preparation, Reflect and Revenge.
details: Bash adds damage equal to 350–450% of Armour value.
Preparation reduces all ability cooldowns by 12 seconds on activation.
Reflect returns 100% incoming damage plus 10–15% Armour value and can hit eight nearby targets.
Revenge duration and cooldown double and its maximum stacks rise to 20.

blessings.name: Demon's Mark
blessings.summary: Accuracy always uses the target's weakness.
details: Accuracy is calculated using the target's weakness.

blessings.name: Splash Zone
blessings.summary: Boosts multi-target damage and scales AoE with target footprint.
details: Area-of-effect and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
AoE abilities deal 5% more damage per tile occupied by the target.

blessings.name: Sacred Fervor
blessings.summary: Reduces ability and special-attack cooldowns for every style.
details: Melee, Magic, Ranged and Necromancy ability and special-attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.

blessings.name: Havoc Born
blessings.summary: A direct damage increase with large defensive penalties.
details: Damage +20%.
Maximum life points −25%.
Armour value −25%.

blessings.name: True Equilibrium
blessings.summary: Adds a stat package once per distinct relic alignment.
details: Per relic alignment: +75 base ability damage, +50 Armour, +500 life points, +5% critical chance, +7.5% critical damage and +5 Prayer bonus.
blessings.blocker: Relic alignment data is not published in a machine-verifiable source; the current Equilibrium engine incorrectly derives this from Blessing paths.

blessings.name: Higher Power
blessings.summary: Raises base ability damage but removes style ultimates.
details: Base ability damage +30%.
Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death and Sunshine become unavailable.

blessings.name: Unholy Critual
blessings.summary: Converts critical chance into critical damage and unleashes Inferno on critical strikes.
details: Critical chance +15% and capped at 50%.
Excess critical chance converts to critical damage at 1:1.
Inferno of Zamorak gains +50% critical damage.
Critical strikes unleash a 100–200% single-target Inferno.

blessings.name: Tearing Thorns
blessings.summary: Doubles DoT duration and makes every fifth DoT hit trigger Grasp.
details: Damage-over-time abilities last 100% longer.
Every fifth DoT-ability hit triggers Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp adds 10–20.30% of maximum life points and deals 80–120% ability damage as poison in a 3×3 area.

blessings.name: Lord of Light
blessings.summary: Basic attacks trigger five armour- and Prayer-scaled Light hits.
details: Basic attacks trigger five Light of Saradomin effects on random nearby tiles, each hitting up to eight targets within one tile; 14.4-second cooldown.
Light deals 2% more damage per Prayer-bonus point and heals 5% of damage dealt.
Each Light deals 40–60% ability damage plus 250% Armour value.

blessings.name: Perfidious
blessings.summary: Empowers all three God-proc effects.
details: Inferno of Zamorak activation chance is multiplied by five.
Grasp of Guthix requires two reductions to activate.
Light of Saradomin cooldown becomes 4.8 seconds.

blessings.name: Envenomed
blessings.summary: Greatly scales poison and removes immunity after damage.
details: Poison damage +50%, plus 2% per Herblore level.
Damaging an enemy disables its poison immunity for 30 seconds.

blessings.name: Tempered Heart
blessings.summary: Provides continuous adrenaline.
details: Generate 6% adrenaline every 1.2 seconds.

blessings.name: Chaotic Insight
blessings.summary: Every combat item counts as three pieces toward set effects.
details: Each combat equipment item counts as two additional pieces toward its set effect.

blessings.name: Power Archive
blessings.summary: Stores extra gizmos and doubles eligible combat-perk ranks.
details: The Automaton Control Bot stores up to 20 weapon or armour gizmos and grants their effects while augmented gear is worn.
Eligible combat perks in stored gizmos have doubled rank.

blessings.name: Genesis Essence
blessings.summary: Treats equipped weapons as tier 120.
details: Equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.

verifiedMechanics.summary: The Invention tutorial is auto-completed and Invention can be trained without Asgarnia; the Invention Guild and machines still require Asgarnia.
Big Boned applies to almost all player-sourced damage, including Conjures, but not familiars or dreadnips.
Splash Zone uses NPC config size: a size-5 target occupies 25 tiles and receives the corresponding per-tile bonus.
The 30,000 damage cap and life-point cap are removed for this League.
Area tasks requiring multiple regions are auto-skipped/auto-completed on region unlock.
WikiSync is available for task progress.
Clues, tetracompasses, Slayer tasks and Reaper tasks respect unlocked regions.
Survivalist's doubled resources do not award doubled XP.
Necromancy and the City of Um are in Misthalin; Kili's Knowledge tasks are skipped.
The official FAQ says Bryll's reward shop is available outside the Wilderness wall, but later also calls Daemonheim/the shop Wilderness-locked. Do not score shop access until this is clarified.

sourceConflicts.summary: The official Blessing uses relic alignment, while the current Equilibrium engine counts Blessing paths. Benchmarks using the current resolver are rejected.
Two statements in the official FAQ conflict on reward-shop access without Wilderness.
